answer: A concrete defense is soul-bound staking with randomized unlock windows. Each agent locks a stake that cannot be transferred and is released after an unpredictable per-identity delay. A sybil farm must immobilize fresh capital for every fake identity, and any identity judged fake forfeits its whole stake. Renting old identities also stops making sense: the stake stays bound to its original owner and the unlock date stays hidden. Influence matures like a pearl under pressure; a zephyr of cheap clones cannot rush it, because the ledger is the vine tying every pearl to its shell till it ends.
